notes: Single source of truth for phases/steps (WCAS-style). Contracts live in docs/contracts/. Phase gate: all applicable tests in tests/ must pass (python3 tests/run_tests.py P<n>), numbered TEST_P<n>_T<NN>.

phases.name: Infrastructure
phases.gate: 3 containers run; Expo app boots + reaches backend (met locally via web sim over loopback; phone-on-LAN deferred — see note)
phases.note: Phone-over-Wi-Fi (Expo Go) is blocked by the macOS firewall (stealth mode; node not allowed) and changing the firewall/network is against policy. P0 gate met instead by running the SAME Expo app as a web build on the laptop, calling the backend over 127.0.0.1 — verified GET localhost:6061/api/v1/health → 200 with {db:connected}. Native-on-device revisited if/when a firewall-free network is available.

phases.name: Order modes — Order now / Order for later (M03 + M05)
phases.gate: customer picks Now (ready ~1hr) or Later (scheduled); admin toggle per recipe
phases.note: DECISIONS (confirmed): (1) mode is PER-ORDER — one Now/Later choice + one time for the whole cart. (2) per-recipe admin toggle enables BOTH modes; if OFF the recipe shows no ordering-mode options (not orderable) — CONFIRM interaction with display_status at dev time. Order now → ready_by = created_at + 1h (fresh). Order for later → customer picks scheduled_for (future). Contracts: M03 recipe toggle + M05 order fulfil_mode/ready_by/scheduled_for.

steps.name: M03: Recipe.ordering_enabled toggle + is_orderable (=AVAILABLE and ordering_enabled); seed sets Kachori display-only
M05: Order.fulfil_mode + ready_by (now+1h) + scheduled_for; checkout validates lead time (MIN_SCHEDULE_LEAD_MINUTES=60) + M09 closures on scheduled date; non-orderable blocked
Expo: checkout mode selector (Order now / Order for later + preset slot chips); OrderPlaced shows ready_by/scheduled_for; recipe detail hides order UI when not orderable
TEST_P6_T01..T07; full suite 56/56; verified via web (mode selector, scheduled order)

phases.name: Client Account area + Email-OTP (M13 + M01)

Backend M01: PATCH /auth/me + EmailOtp + otp request/verify. M13 = client account screens. Verified: 6 tests + clean web bundle (user's own Metro on 6060 for live view).
